entryEvidence.proposedMeaning: A compact allusion to the Dayu Ridge case, where Huiming cannot lift the robe and bowl.
entryEvidence.proposedConciseTarget: could not lift it at Dayu Ridge
alternateTargets: at Dayu Ridge it could not be lifted
translationRisks: The omitted object is supplied by the inherited robe-and-bowl case, not by the graphs in isolation.
In the retained witness Poshan utters an allusion while receiving a Dharma robe; Huiming and Huineng remain embedded case figures.
Collapse all robe-and-bowl recensions and later imperial or robe-presentation allusions into one case family.
entryEvidence.familyCollapseRuling: One Huiming-at-Dayu-Ridge robe-and-bowl case and its active allusions.

selectedWitnesses.titleEn: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Poshan
selectedWitnesses.kwic: 金粟專使送法衣至，上堂，師云：「大庾嶺頭提不起，雞足山前成滯貨，山僧今日獲一披，如雲普覆華王座。大眾記取：三十年後切不可動著。何也？動著則禍生。」
selectedWitnesses.deployment: On receiving a Dharma robe, Poshan directly invokes the Dayu Ridge inability-to-lift episode and contrasts it with his receiving and wearing the robe today.
selectedWitnesses.actorReview: Poshan is the direct utterer in 師云. Huiming is the implicit unable-to-lift performer in the inherited case; the robe and bowl are the omitted case objects.
